rules.rule: a record with an empty purpose, or a data map with no purpose column
a record with an empty lawful basis, or a data map with no lawful basis column
a lawful basis that is none of consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, legitimate interests and the 13 aliases of the configuration
a record with an empty category, or a data map with no category column
a record whose category is one of the eight special categories of Article 9(1), or one of the 22 aliases for them, with an empty special category condition
a record whose category is criminal convictions and offences, or an alias for it
a record with an empty retention, or a data map with no retention column
a retention that says the data is kept with no end
a retention that names no period the tool can read and no word for an open end
a record with an empty storage location, or a data map with no location column
a record stored in or sent to a place outside the EU/EEA, with an empty transfer safeguard; places named by the 1 alias of the configuration are read as their codes
a transfer whose safeguard holds a name that is not one of Articles 45, 46, 47 or 49
a transfer on an adequacy decision to a place with no decision on the list the tool knows, or with a decision of limited scope
a transfer whose only safeguard is a derogation for a specific situation
a record with consent among its lawful bases and an empty consent reference
a record that names a processor or recipient and no agreement reference
a record with an empty owner, or a data map with no owner column
a record whose system, store, field and purpose an earlier record already has
a record of the data map with no field, the wrong number of fields or a value of the wrong kind
a data map that the tool could not read as UTF-8 text
a data map that the CSV or JSON reader refuses, or whose header or shape is not that of a data map

basis.text: processing data that reveals racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and genetic, biometric, health and sex life or sexual orientation data, is prohibited unless a condition of Article 9(2) applies
basis.source: Art. 9 GDPR, Processing of special categories of personal data (gdpr-info.eu)

basis.text: the conditions of Article 9(2) include explicit consent, employment and social protection law, vital interests, data made public by the person, legal claims, substantial public interest, health care, public health and research

basis.text: the regulation defines genetic data, biometric data that identifies a person through technical processing, and data concerning health, which includes information on health care that reveals the state of health

findings.own: a category is special when its name, an alias, or the longest name or alias it holds as whole words is one of Article 9(1), so "health records" is health; an alias set to other marks a word as ordinary data; any text in the condition column counts as a condition, the tool cannot tell whether it applies
